Brief Description
Design signal oriented communication between CP and AP
Description
Usually, Adaptive Applications communicate between each other in a service oriented manner.
There is even an option that applications deployed to an Adaptive Platform and Classic Platform
communicate in a service oriented way via SOME/IP.
If the counterpart on a Classic Platform ECU, however, communicates only in a signal-based way, a
Signal-to-Service translation is needed.
